purpose: Surface authority-sync freshness degradation before the existing fail-closed freshness boundary rejects privileged Shine Defence ingest.

states.meaning: The latest signed authority-sync receipt is comfortably inside the existing fail-closed freshness window.
The latest signed authority-sync receipt is still admissible but has crossed the early-warning threshold.
The underlying authority-sync summary is already warning because authority state is missing, mismatched or stale; privileged ingest remains fail-closed.

invariants: The Sentinel is advisory and read-only; it never records authority state, refreshes a heartbeat, retries a workflow or mutates release truth.
The Sentinel never extends or relaxes the 5400-second authority freshness limit enforced by privileged ingest.
The early-warning threshold must remain strictly lower than the fail-closed threshold.
A warning generated before expiry is visible in the full-estate summary without changing the underlying authority-sync admission result.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
